scope: Weak sideways drive, through first order in material intake in the spherical relaxed viscous exterior. Signed inward transported axial momentum and external Cauchy stress. The native material conversion surface has no supplied identification with this sphere.

sympy.command: setsid --fork nohup python3 scripts/s11c_guarded_run.py --pool mouth-conversion-momentum --memory-gib 2 --log-directory _scratch/s11c/mouth_conversion_sympy01 -- python3 software/stage1_solver/tools/mouth_conversion_momentum.py > _scratch/s11c/mouth_conversion_sympy01.launch.log 2>&1 < /dev/null
stdout: rim velocity contribution: 4*pi*q*rho*(3*V + W + 2*b)/3 | 4*pi*q*rho*(3*V + W + 2*b)/3 | residual 0
rim lab axial momentum rate: 4*pi*q*rho*(3*V + W + 3*b)/3 | 4*pi*q*rho*(3*V + W + 3*b)/3 | residual 0
lab shift of carried rate: 4*pi*q*rho*shift | 4*pi*q*rho*shift | residual 0
net flux independent of radius: 2*pi*(2*V*q*rho + 2*W*a*eta + W*q*rho - 2*a*b*eta + b*q*rho) | 2*pi*(2*V*q*rho + 2*W*a*eta + W*q*rho - 2*a*b*eta + b*q*rho) | residual 0
combined inward relative momentum rate: 2*pi*(2*W*a*eta + W*q*rho - 2*a*b*eta + b*q*rho) | 2*pi*(2*W*a*eta + W*q*rho - 2*a*b*eta + b*q*rho) | residual 0

wolfram.command: setsid --fork nohup python3 scripts/s11c_guarded_run.py --pool mouth-conversion-momentum --memory-gib 4 --tasks-max 64 --log-directory _scratch/s11c/mouth_conversion_wolfram01 -- math -noprompt -script software/stage1_solver/tools/mouth_conversion_momentum.wl > _scratch/s11c/mouth_conversion_wolfram01.launch.log 2>&1 < /dev/null
stdout: "held rim carriage per mass"" | ""(3*b + w)/3"" | ""b + w/3"" | residual ""0"
"moving rim carriage per mass"" | ""(3*b + 3*v + w)/3"" | ""b + v + w/3"" | residual ""0"
"stress change vs inward carriage lost"" | ""(-4*dens*Pi*q*(a - radius)*(b - w))/radius"" | ""(-4*dens*Pi*q*(a - radius)*(b - w))/radius"" | residual ""0"
"relative total at rim"" | ""-2*Pi*(2*a*b*eta - b*dens*q - 2*a*eta*w - dens*q*w)"" | ""4*a*eta*Pi*(-b + w) + 2*dens*Pi*q*(b + w)"" | residual ""0"
